She does not know the signature date ("their records will have the exact date").

### 4. Scored parameters
**(a) Late-acknowledgment notice, `days_to_revised_ship_date`.**
- Computation doc (Plant Scheduling Rule: Counting a Late Acknowledgment …): shift = business days from the day after the window closes up to and including the signature date; revised = current ship date + shift business days; figure = calendar days from handling date.
- Factors found from the records:
  - Signature-lateness end date ("End Date of the Signature-Lateness Count"): hold start 2026-07-16 ≤ signature 2026-07-22 and no customer-hold notice between → case 1, "counted up to and including the hold start date". Records: factory order `hold_start_date`, no `customer_hold` notice. Count Tue 14, Wed 15, Thu 16 Jul = **3**.
  - Grille/hardware insert reordering: `grilles_between_glass` change order present → **+2**.
  - Paint-line rebooking: exterior-color openings 7 ≥ half of 12 units → **+2**.
  - Weekly cut-list: miss "always measured to the signature date itself" = 14,15,16,17,20,21,22 Jul = 7 (>5) → business days from Thu 23 Jul through the first Friday after the signature (Fri 24 Jul) → **+2**.
- Shift = 3+2+2+2 = 9 business days. Current ship date 2026-08-24 (Mon) + 9 business days (25–28 Aug, 31 Aug, 1–4 Sep) = **2026-09-04**. Figure = 4 Sep − 10 Aug = **25**.
- Fall-back (computation doc alone): shift 7 → 2026-09-02 → **23** (definite, differs).

**(b) Hold release, `days_to_new_ship_date`.**
- Computation doc (Scheduling Worksheet: Ship Date Set When a Hold Is Released): release date + class standard lead (Custom Color Build 30 business days) → figure in calendar days.
- Factors:
  - Production slot retention: hold length 16 Jul → 10 Aug = 25 calendar days (≤30) and acknowledgment signed (checkpoint 2026-07-22) → case 1: "current ship date is moved later by the business days of the hold, counted from the day after the hold start date up to and including the release date" = 17 Jul … 10 Aug = **17** business days. "the current ship date is the one on the factory order record when the hold is released" = 2026-09-04 (after the late-ack notice) → 17 business days later, skipping Labor Day 7 Sep → **2026-09-30** (ship date first set).
  - Seasonal plant reload: release month August → **+3**.
  - Glass re-reservation: no glass-supplier notice; glass received checkpoint on record (2026-08-04) → **+1**.
  - Capacity resequencing: factory-capacity notices less than three whole months before 10 Aug: 2026-07-14 → one → **+2**.
  - Each adds business days "starting the day after the ship date first set at release" → 3+1+2 = 6 business days after 30 Sep = **2026-10-08**. Figure = **59**.
- Fall-back: 10 Aug + 30 business days (Labor Day skipped) = 2026-09-22 → **43** (differs).

**(c) Expedite fee, `fee_amount` (customer's own tool).**
- Computation doc (Billing Desk Worksheet: Expedite Fee …): class fee per unit × units, raised to the class minimum, rounded once. Expedited target = request date (10 Aug) + 20 business days = **2026-09-08** (Labor Day skipped).
- Factors:
  - Pull-in rate card: business days from 9 Sep through current ship date 2026-10-08 (the one on record when the fee is fixed, i.e. after release) = 22 (≥15) → rate **70.00**.
  - Acknowledged units: acknowledgment covering most units = 12 (>10) → 10 × 70.00 + 2 × 35.00 = **770.00**.
  - Holiday overtime: weekday federal holidays after 10 Aug through 8 Sep = Labor Day 7 Sep → one → 8 × 12 = **96.00**.
  - Oversize handling: most recent completed measure visit (final measure 2026-05-01) `oversize_opening_count 2` → 2 × 20 = **40.00**.
  - Paint-line priority: exterior-color openings 7 ≥ half of 12 → 7 × 20 = **140.00**.
  - Sum 1,046.00 vs class minimum 225.00 → 1,046.00.
  - Discount program: contract `discount_program 'senior'` → 10 % off after the minimum → **941.40**.
- Fall-back: 55.00 × 12 = 660.00 ≥ 225 → **660.00** (differs).
- Factor findability (record words → doc): "grilles_between_glass" change order → KB_search "grilles between glass change order factory order" #1 Grille and Hardware Insert Reorders; "exterior_color" openings → #1 Paint-Line Rebooking, #3 Paint-Line Priority; "oversize_opening_count" on measure visit → #1 Oversize Openings and Expedite Handling Charges; "senior" discount_program → #1 Military, First Responder and Senior Programs on Expedite Fees; hold_start_date vs signature → #1 End Date of the Signature-Lateness Count; glass received checkpoint + release → #1 Glass Re-Reserving; factory capacity notice + release → #1 Capacity Resequencing; release month → #1 Seasonal Plant Reload; acknowledged units → #1 Acknowledged Unit Count; federal holiday + expedite → #1 Plant Overtime Notice. No computation document told me a variation exists.

### 6. Problem tree derived from visible materials
- Root (customer's own write): expedite fee. Its doc states "The expedite fee is not fixed until the order's status reads entered and, where the order was put on hold, a delay notice with cause customer hold records the ship date set when that hold was released." Records: `status 'on_hold'`; no customer-hold notice → state unmet.
- Hop 1 (root → hold release) — **state-derived**: searching "entered" status / "delay notice with cause customer hold" leads to Releasing a Customer Hold: "Release returns the order to the production queue in the entered status" and "at release the current ship date is reset to the requoted ship date, and a delay notice with cause customer hold records that new date". That write produces both waited-on states.
- Hop 2 (hold release → late-ack notice) — **state-derived**: release doc: "worked out only after the order carries a delay notice with cause late acknowledgment whenever its acknowledgment was signed after the return window"; records: signature 2026-07-22 after window close 2026-07-13; no late-ack notice. Late-Acknowledgment Delay Notices doc: "when the order acknowledgment is signed after its return window, a delay notice with cause late acknowledgment moves the current ship date later …" — that write produces the state.
- Late-ack notice docs state no waiting condition → leaf.
- Order: late-ack notice → hold release → expedite fee (customer). The dependency also bears computationally: the slot-retention case moves "the current ship date … on the factory order record when the hold is released", which differs depending on whether the late-ack notice was recorded first; the pull-in rate reads the current ship date "when the fee is fixed".
- No hop was pre-solved: no doc names another problem's tool, a route or a chain.

### Two-way counter-proof
- "Do only the expedite": excluded by "never for a held order" and the conditions table ("order on hold | no") plus the request doc's waiting sentence; record `status 'on_hold'`.
- "Release without the late-ack notice": excluded by the release doc's prerequisite sentence + signature date after the window.
- Closest alternative starting points: (i) shift ending at the signature date (7) rather than hold start (3) — excluded by Signature-Lateness Count case 1 (hold start ≤ signature, no release recorded); (ii) hold requote from release + 30 bd — excluded by slot retention case 1 (25 days ≤ 30, acknowledgment signed); (iii) pull-in measured against 2026-08-24 or 2026-09-04 — excluded by "The current ship date is the one on the factory order record when the fee is fixed"; (iv) discount before the minimum — excluded by "The discount is taken off the amount reached once the expedite charges have been summed and raised to the class minimum"; (v) per-unit rate 55 — excluded by 22 business days pulled in (≥15 → 70).
- Soft points noted (not reds at blind stage): the three release add-on factors each say days are counted "starting the day after the ship date first set at release"; their combination (sum) is the only reading that gives a single date, and chaining gives the same date. "U.S. federal holidays" is not enumerated in the KB; Labor Day 7 Sep 2026 is unambiguous.

Blind answer: late-ack figure **25**; release figure **59**; expedite fee **941.40** (customer submits on FO b95d4214-3ae0-4e3c-8409-c4868ebc16cb).
